Product Details: UNI-T UTL8211+ 400W DC Electronic Load Tester – 150V / 40A Programmable High-Precision Load with LCD, CC/CV/CR/CP Modes, RS232 Control & Multi-Protection for Power Supply, Battery Testing By Skyking - Distributed/Packaged by Uni-T. Product Details: The UNI-T UTL8211+ DC Electronic Load is a high-precision, programmable single-channel load tester designed for accurate performance evaluation of power supplies, batteries, chargers, adapters, and electronic components. With a maximum load capacity of 400 W, 150 V, and 40 A, it delivers reliable and repeatable results for both laboratory and production environments. Equipped with a bright 2.8-inch color LCD display, the UTL8211+ clearly shows voltage, current, power, and operating mode in real time. It supports multiple operating modes including Constant Current (CC), Constant Voltage (CV), Constant Resistance (CR), and Constant Power (CP), making it suitable for a wide range of test scenarios. The instrument features dynamic load testing, list mode automation, short-circuit simulation, and battery discharge testing, enabling engineers and technicians to perform comprehensive stress and reliability tests. High measurement resolution and fast response ensure accurate simulation of real-world load conditions. For enhanced safety and long-term reliability, the UNI-T UTL8211+ includes multiple protection mechanisms such as over-voltage, over-current, over-power, over-temperature, and reverse polarity protection. An integrated cooling system ensures stable operation even during extended high-power testing.
